title: Artifact-First Spec-Driven Development (SDD) & Altitude Boundary Protocol: Chat Dump Prohibition and Semantic Range Isolation
author: Jim Quinn, Elise Ewing, Dave Rensin (Google LLC, 2026; synthesized by Brain Harness)

claims.assertion: Dumping multi-page proposals, specs, or review findings directly into chat panes degrades LLM token context, causes conversational fatigue, and breaks reproducibility; all long-form assets must be emitted to dedicated workspace artifacts or files.

Design specifications must strictly partition content into semantic altitude ranges: FeatureRange (high-level goals, architecture, YAGNI, alternatives) and DetailedRange (concrete file paths, function signatures, test scenarios, rollout phases).

Altitude violations must be audited separately: high-level architecture must not contain helper function implementations, and detailed implementation plans must not alter core system boundaries without upstream re-audit.
